name: clean-python-code
description: Personalized Python and PySpark formatting with hierarchical indentation, vertically aligned nested delimiters, vertical chains, and aligned nested expressions.

cleanPythonCode.outerIndent.description: Spaces used to indent the first line inside a top-level grouping relative to the rendered opening delimiter.

cleanPythonCode.chainIndent.description: Additional spaces from the first fluent-chain dot column used to align continuation dots.

cleanPythonCode.argumentIndent.description: Spaces used to indent multiline call arguments or collection contents relative to the rendered opening delimiter.

cleanPythonCode.maxInlineLength.description: Soft expression length threshold. Short calls stay compact; existing multiline argument lists are retained. Long indivisible literals may exceed this value.

cleanPythonCode.leadingComma.description: Use leading commas in expanded calls and collections. Disabled by default; delimiters containing comments always use trailing commas to preserve comment placement.

cleanPythonCode.expandBooleanOperators.description: Expose boolean conditions with matched parentheses and operator-led lines. Independent of arithmeticLayout.

cleanPythonCode.pythonPath.description: Path to a Python 3.9+ executable (no command-line arguments). Empty: use the selected Microsoft Python environment, then Python on PATH. Use a Python version that supports your source syntax.

enumDescriptions: Keep short equations inline; split long equations at the main operator level.
Do not force arithmetic operator line breaks. Calls, comments and collections retain their layout rules.
Expand compound arithmetic recursively, as in version 0.6.0.
cleanPythonCode.arithmeticLayout.description: Arithmetic layout policy, independent of boolean predicate formatting. Auto uses maxInlineLength as a soft expression-width threshold.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Starts a local Python interpreter to parse and format selected code.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Requires a Python interpreter on the extension host.
